description: This file contains utility functions for mapping statuses and strings to colors, intended for use in UI components to ensure consistent and accessible color coding for various statuses and categories. It includes functions for generating deterministic pastel colors from strings and for mapping common status descriptors to theme-defined color tokens.

methods.name: colorFromString(key, { saturation = 55, lightness = 55 } = {})
methods.description: Deterministically generates a pastel HSL color string based on an input string, ensuring different strings produce distinct but harmonious colors suitable for dark backgrounds.

methods.name: getStatusColor(status, oc)
methods.description: Maps a given status string to a theme-specific color if known, otherwise generates a deterministic color based on the string. Handles common statuses like 'processing', 'success', 'failed', and 'unknown'.
